File mtimes show the package and FINDINGS.jsonl were refreshed at 01:12:00/01:12:11 after the closure wrote report/manifest at 01:11:34, and no final closure was run. Consequences: (1) fresh artifact_confinement.py without R3_RECORD_EVIDENCE returns passed=false, manifest_failures=1, hidden=0, evidence_bytes=2986060 under 4194304, reproduction exits [0,0]; (2) reproduce_closure.py run twice as separate invocations prints IDEMPOTENT=True, exit 0, but produces report bf191645e2cd558558a0faac8586bc9d718461b1c5892348906f90933e5fb3f0 and manifest 943251c20f79e2a0a6158206e717e06be3c4da0ca7c42a4c08069983ba3d586c on every run, not the frozen d859716d1cabbe3fe2b7f8aa28bc2d5ac47534c58840d19e77f1fbdba7f35438/3bc57aab056d232b551a470ee9734e514fca275f99be5d6e9563b89e802cec35; a direct close_r3_evidence.py run exits 0 with the same non-frozen hashes and final check passed=true only against the regenerated state. The recorded confinement evidence (passed=true, failures=[], evidence_bytes=2964843) is also stale: it predates the round-3 verdict, typing/bandit refresh, and final closure. This breaks the round-3 repair claim that the frozen closure binds current disk.
